chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

When it is the Day of qiyamah, a group from among the people will rise until they come to the gate of Jannah and knock at its gate. It will be said to them, “Who are you?” They will say, “We are the poor.” It will be said to them, “Before the reckoning?” They will say, “You did not give us anything for which You would call us to account.” Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will say, “They have spoken the truth; enter Jannah.”

key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the abode of eternal reward
key_terms.الْحِسَابِ: the reckoning; divine accounting of deeds and blessings
key_terms.الْفُقَرَاءُ: the poor; those without worldly means
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final judgment

ai.seo_question: How does al-Kāfī describe the entry of poor believers into Jannah before reckoning?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a group of poor people who are admitted to Jannah before the reckoning on the Day of qiyamah. It highlights the spiritual station of the poor believers and shows that lacking worldly possessions can mean having little or nothing to be called to account for.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When it will be the Day of Judgement, necks from the people would rise until they come over to the Door of the Paradise, so they would be knocking the Door of the Paradise. So it would be said to them: ‘Who are you all?’ So they would be saying, ‘We are the poor ones’. So it would be said to them: ‘Before the Reckoning?’ So they would be saying, ‘You<sup>azwj</sup> did not Give us anything for us to be Reckoned upon’. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would be Saying: “They are speaking the truth. Enter them into the Paradise’’.
en.sarwar: 19. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

When it will be the Day of Judgment certain necks of people will rise, approach the door of paradise and knock on it. They will be asked, ‘Who are you?’ They will say, ‘We are the poor people.’ They will be told, ‘Show your accounts.’ They will say, ‘You did not give us anything. Why do you ask us for accounts?’ Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, will say they have spoken the truth admit them into paradise.’”
